arguments.query: select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("bookings","outbox","charges","holds")

select o.event_id,o.booking_id,o.status,o.attempts,o.payload from outbox o where o.status!="delivered" union all select b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,coalesce(c.charge_id,"-")||" "||coalesce(c.state,"-")||" "||coalesce(c.idempotency_key,"-") from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,b.flight_id,coalesce(c.charge_id,"-")||" "||coalesce(c.state,"-")||" "||coalesce(c.idempotency_key,"-")||" "||coalesce(c.amount_cents,"-") ch from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) c,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) o from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed" or h=0 or k=0 or o!="delivered" or c!="captured" order by 1 desc limit 20
select "fh" t,f.* ,"" x from fare_holds f union all select "cache",key,value,"","" from cache union all select "fl",flight_id,fare_cents,version,capacity from flights
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("flights","fare_holds","cache")

select "fh" t,hold_id a,flight_id b,price_cents c,until_step d from fare_holds union all select "cache",key,value,"","" from cache union all select "fl",flight_id,price_cents,version,capacity from flights
select step,flight_id,status,message from (select rowid step,path flight_id,status,message from request_logs where message like "stale%" order by rowid desc limit 3)
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 6
